name: Singapore Management University
summary: City-centre Singapore university founded in 2000 with seven schools, seminar classes of up to 45 and a guaranteed second major.

ib.text: May sitters apply on teacher-attested predicted scores (self-declared ones are refused). Law needs grade 6 or 7 in English A; Economics and Computer Science need a good pass in IB Maths. Ask SMU for a minimum total.

programmes.name: Business Management
programmes.about: A business degree at the Lee Kong Chian School of Business built on ten majors, from Finance and Marketing to Digital Business and Sustainability, taught in small interactive classes with a guaranteed second major.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of predicted IB results; shortlisted applicants are interviewed (online if you live outside Singapore, as in 2026). No minimum total is quoted.

flagshipSource.title: Lee Kong Chian School of Business: ten majors, triple-crown accredited, guaranteed second major

programmes.name: Accountancy
programmes.about: A broad-based degree with a strong accounting core that adds business, data analytics, digital technology and sustainability; the school is accredited by ten professional and educational bodies.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of predicted IB results; shortlisted applicants are interviewed (online if you live outside Singapore, as in 2026). No minimum total is quoted.

flagshipSource.title: School of Accountancy: accredited by ten professional and educational bodies

programmes.name: Law
programmes.about: A law degree at the Yong Pung How School of Law in the city centre, taught in seminars, with international moots, exchange and internships, and law-related electives that put the subject in context.
programmes.ib: Grade 6 or 7 in English A (Literature, or Language and Literature) at HL or SL; other English profiles are considered case by case.
programmes.selectionNote: Shortlisted applicants sit an in-person writing test at SMU, then the further shortlisted are interviewed. Dates are set each year.

flagshipSource.title: Yong Pung How School of Law: seminar teaching, international moots, city-centre building

faculties.name: School of Accountancy
faculties.line: Bachelor of Accountancy; predicted IB results, then an interview if shortlisted.

faculties.name: Lee Kong Chian School of Business
faculties.line: Bachelor of Business Management with ten majors; predicted IB results, then an interview if shortlisted.

faculties.name: School of Economics
faculties.line: BSc Economics; a good pass in IB Maths at HL or SL is expected.

faculties.name: School of Computing and Information Systems
faculties.line: Information Systems, Computer Science, Computing and Law, Software Engineering; Computer Science needs a good pass in IB Maths.

faculties.name: School of Social Sciences
faculties.line: Psychology, Political Science and Sociology, or Politics, Law and Economics; predicted IB results, then an interview if shortlisted.

faculties.name: Yong Pung How School of Law
faculties.line: Grade 6 or 7 in English A, then a writing test and interview for those shortlisted.

faculties.name: College of Integrative Studies
faculties.line: Explore for a year before declaring a degree, or design your own individualised major.

notes: EU students can take the MOE Tuition Grant, which cuts the fee but requires you to work for a Singapore entity for three years after graduating.
Fees are fixed for your cohort across the normal four years; without the grant the Business Management fee is S$47,700 a year (2026/27).
SMU asks for official IB results sent directly by the IB once you accept an offer and enrol, even if you first self-report your results.
